data.name: 矮人炮弹 Dwarven Cannonball
data.detailed_description:
Dwarf Cannon: Coin Pusher × Arkanoid × Roguelite!

You no longer control a paddle—instead, you launch dwarves as projectiles. Each ricochet unleashes a coin-pusher frenzy of gold: smash obstacles, blast enemies, and watch treasures rain down!

7 Weapons, 7 Skill Trees
Equip your dwarves with rocket hammers, explosive crossbows, boomerang axes… Each weapon features its own unique skill tree. Combine with weapon cards to reshape your trajectory and combat style.

Build Your Deck, Command Your Strategy
Do you focus on massive single-shot damage, or create a ricochet storm that sweeps the battlefield? Every run is a fresh build, and every choice changes the course of battle.

Delve into the Dungeon
Recruit more dwarves, unlock powerful talents. With every bounce, wealth and power soar together.

Are you ready to send your dwarves on the adventure of a lifetime?
